D/ CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG ; R/ [VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP]

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Two Victories issue of 318-320, London mint, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust helmeted and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreath inscribed VOT / PR over altar, altar bears square or possibly grid pattern. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE LAETAE…
